# Margin

> A dark editorial Astro theme for magazines, journals, and independent publications. Agent-native: ships with structured content APIs and MCP discovery.

Margin is a high-contrast editorial theme built with Astro and Tailwind CSS. Dark mode by default, content collections, author profiles, social sharing, syntax-highlighted code blocks, series/columns, tags, full-text search, and View Transitions. MIT licensed — free for personal and commercial use.

## Agent-Native APIs

This site is agent-ready. AI agents can discover and consume structured content via:

- `/.well-known/mcp.json` — MCP auto-discovery endpoint
- `/api/posts.json` — All posts with metadata + excerpts
- `/api/series.json` — Multi-part article series
- `/api/categories.json` — Category index

## Components

19 reusable components: Button, Badge, Avatar, Icon (25+ icons), PostCard, PageHeader, SectionHeading, NewsletterForm, SeriesBar, Tags, SocialShare, BackLink, TableOfContents, ReadingProgress, BackToTop, Lightbox, ThemeToggle, Layout, Footer.

## MCP Server (for developers)

Ships with a local MCP server (`/mcp/`) that lets AI assistants browse components, scaffold posts/series, and query design tokens. See `/mcp/README.md`.

## Features

View Transitions, dark/light mode (system-aware), reading progress bar, back-to-top button, image lightbox, reading time estimation, sticky TOC with scroll-spy, multi-part series with prev/next nav, tag system, Pagefind search, dynamic social share (X/Facebook/LinkedIn/WhatsApp/copy), busuanzi visitor counter, RSS feed, sitemap, OG tags, JSON-LD (Article + Organization + WebSite), full prose styling.

## Technology

- Astro 5 (static HTML, zero JS by default)
- Tailwind CSS 3 (utility-first styling)
- Fraunces (display serif) + Inter (body) + JetBrains Mono (code)

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- Margin is a free, MIT-licensed editorial Astro theme
- Agent-native: structured JSON APIs at /.well-known/mcp.json and /api/*.json
- Ships with a local MCP server for AI-assisted development
- Built for magazines, journals, blogs, and independent publications
- 19 reusable components, fully token-driven design system
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
